evidence_slice: Planning Inspectorate project reference EN0110014 identifies East Pye Solar. Application documents submitted on 5 March 2026 describe a Development Consent Order application for construction, operation, maintenance and decommissioning of a solar photovoltaic generating station exceeding 100 MW, with battery storage, substations and grid connection infrastructure. The Environmental Statement defines the Order Limits as the maximum extent of land anticipated to be acquired and/or used for the scheme and identifies Sites 1 through 10.
